fact: A document for the PND 2026-2030 financing consultative group of 8-9 July 2026 lists the creation of the National AI Agency (ANIA), an AI task force and the Safe IA label as a project still seeking investment, and records the strategy as presented to the Prime Minister on 13 March 2025.
title: Fiche d'opportunité d'investissement OP_5.03-034, Transition numérique : Intelligence Artificielle (IA)
publisher: Groupe consultatif pour le financement du PND 2026-2030, Côte d'Ivoire
